# Compliance coverage summary

<!-- generated by scripts/compliance-coverage.mjs from the framework files; do not edit by hand -->

The scanner bundles 10 compliance frameworks. Every one has a per-control coverage map below, and each count is read from the framework file the engine evaluates, so a count here cannot drift from what is assessed. None of this is a statement that a project is compliant with, or certified against, a framework.

| Framework | Id | Controls | Automated mapping | Needs attestation | Observable in code (yes / partial / no) | Map |

| General Data Protection Regulation (EU 2016/679) | `gdpr` | 6 | 6 | 0 | 2 / 4 / 0 | [coverage](gdpr-coverage.md) |
| HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164, Subparts C & E) | `hipaa-security-rule` | 8 | 6 | 2 | 4 / 3 / 1 | [coverage](hipaa-security-rule-coverage.md) |
| NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3 — Protecting CUI in Nonfederal Systems | `nist-800-171-r3` | 97 | 49 | 48 | 16 / 38 / 43 | [coverage](nist-800-171-r3-coverage.md) |
| NIST AI 600-1 — Generative AI Profile | `nist-ai-600-1` | 6 | 6 | 0 | 2 / 4 / 0 | [coverage](nist-ai-600-1-coverage.md) |

In all, 260 controls are evaluated across 10 frameworks. The larger frameworks are partly covered: see each map's scope line for what is left out.
